description: Sat you down and dressed the blisters.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Took a hundred, and did not take the pack.
name: Hamnet Shakespeare

description: Took the cloak, and told you to hold still.
name: Joan Shakespeare

description: Took the pack at the town end, and put the flat parcel on top.
name: Richard Shakespeare

description: Looked at your feet and said nothing.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Answered her, and sat in the tub.
name: William Shakespeare
